original_input: I was sick and need to reschedule my calculus exam to a new date.

triage.summary: Student requests to reschedule a calculus exam due to illness.

routing.reason: The student requests an exam reschedule due to illness, which requires formal academic approval and a medical certificate. The Study Office handles exam exceptions, while the Health Service should be notified for the medical documentation.

solution.diagnosis: Student is ill and needs to obtain a medical certificate and submit a formal exam rescheduling request

steps.action: Visit the University Health Service or a general practitioner to obtain a medical certificate covering the illness period
Submit a formal exam rescheduling request through the official student administration system, attaching the medical certificate
Notify the course instructor of the situation and forward the request to the Study Office for approval
Study Office reviews the request and decides on a new exam date or alternative arrangement

time_critical_actions: Obtain a medical certificate promptly from the University Health Service or a GP
Submit the formal rescheduling request with the certificate as soon as possible
assumptions: Student can access the University Health Service during its opening hours
The student has access to the official student administration system to submit the request
lessons_applied: For urgent or time-sensitive cases, fill time_critical_actions with what must happen first. (auditor rejected this 6x before)
Back every step with a knowledge base entry; if none applies, say the case needs a human. (auditor rejected this 7x before)
contact_department must be exactly one of the routed department names. (auditor rejected this 3x before)

communication.channel: Course instructor, then the faculty Study Office
communication.subject: Request to Reschedule Calculus Exam Due to Illness
communication.body:
Dear Study Office,
I am writing to request a rescheduling of my upcoming calculus exam because I am currently ill. I will obtain a medical certificate and submit a formal rescheduling request through the student administration system as soon as possible. Please advise on the next steps and any required documentation.
Thank you,
[Your name]
[student ID]
